_comment: The companion run to manifest.json, and it must be reported separately.
These faults are FILE-SCOPED: a broken module-level import turns the whole
file into one collection error. v1 replaces a failing test *function*, and
a collection error has none, so v1 cannot attempt these at all -- it
records 'failing function could not be located' and spends nothing.
That is a real and interesting difference, but it is a statement about
REACH, not about repair quality. Folding it into the main numbers would
hand v2 a margin it did not earn on prompt quality. Report this run as its
own row: 'observations v1 could not attempt', beside the main fix rate.
